summary.name: IBM Watson
summary.one_liner: IBM's enterprise AI brand and product suite, originating with the Watson question-answering system that won Jeopardy! in 2011 and now centered on the watsonx platform.
summary.what_it_does: The page is IBM's overview of its Watson AI line, tracing its history from Deep Blue and the 2011 Jeopardy! win to cloud availability and Watson Assistant updates. It presents watsonx as the current product family, described as able to train, validate, tune and deploy foundation and machine learning models. Listed capabilities include scaling AI workloads across data, building AI virtual agents without code, and offering AI-generated code recommendations to developers. The text is mostly marketing and history, with few concrete technical specifications.
notable: Watson won the 2011 Jeopardy! challenge against Brad Rutter and Ken Jennings
watsonx is the current generative AI and machine learning platform
Watson Assistant offers no-code virtual agent building
caveats: Page does not state pricing or plan details
Mostly historical and promotional text with few technical specifics
